$comment: Hand-made squads for stand-in teams with no T20Is near the edition. Sources: Wikipedia '2012 ICC World Twenty20 Qualifier' (Squads section, UAE, March 2012; Namibia finished 3rd) plus each player's Wikipedia article for dob/handedness/bowling. Namibia had no T20I status in 2012 so Cricsheet has no ball-by-ball data. shortName follows Cricsheet initials+surname style. Compiled 2026-10-28.

players.name: Sarel Burger
players.notes: Captain (c) in qualifier squad list. Full name Sarel Francois Burger. Infobox: right-arm medium-fast, all-rounder. 53 vs Oman (PoM); 3/16 vs Afghanistan in Qualifying Final 1.

players.name: Raymond van Schoor
players.notes: Vice-captain and (wk) in qualifier squad list. Player of the Tournament: 324 runs in 9 inns, avg 54.00, SR 110.95, HS 79*, 3 fifties. Infobox role wicket-keeper; text calls him an occasional keeper. Bowls right-arm off break.

players.name: Gerhard Erasmus
players.notes: Full name Merwe Gerhard Erasmus. Aged 16 at the tournament; squad member only (later Namibia captain). Infobox: right-arm off break, all-rounder.

players.name: Hendrik Geldenhuys
players.notes: Infobox: left-handed, left-arm fast-medium. No role stated on Wikipedia; 'bowler' inferred from bowling style. Article flagged as lacking inline citations.

players.name: Zhivago Groenewald
players.notes: UNCONFIRMED bowling and role: Wikipedia infobox gives left-handed batting only, no bowling style or role. Aged 18 at the tournament.

players.name: Louis Klazinga
players.notes: Infobox: right-arm fast-medium. No role stated on Wikipedia; 'bowler' inferred from bowling style and 4/9 vs Kenya (PoM) at the qualifier.

players.name: Ian Opperman
players.notes: International debut at this qualifier; played all 9 Namibia matches but batted only 4 innings and bowled 3.1 overs. Article text calls him an all-rounder; infobox: right-arm off-spin.

players.name: Bernard Scholtz
players.notes: Full name Bernard Martinus Scholtz. Article: right-handed batsman and slow left-arm bowler. No role field; 'bowler' inferred.

players.name: Nicolaas Scholtz
players.notes: Qualifier squad list spells him 'Nicholaas Scholtz'; article title is Nicolaas Reimert Petrus Scholtz. Infobox: left-handed, leg break. Role not stated on Wikipedia (left blank; in Namibian sides he is primarily a batter).

players.name: Gerrie Snyman
players.notes: Infobox: right-arm fast-medium, all-rounder. 78 vs Italy at the qualifier.

players.name: Ewald Steenkamp
players.notes: (wk) in qualifier squad list; infobox role wicket-keeper, no bowling field.

players.name: Christi Viljoen
players.notes: Full name Christoffel Viljoen. Infobox: right-arm medium, all-rounder. Namibia's top wicket-taker at the qualifier: 14 wkts in 9 matches, avg 12.71, econ 7.02, best 4/8 vs Oman; 48 runs from 5 inns.

players.name: Louis van der Westhuizen
players.notes: Full name Louis Petrus van der Westhuizen. Article: generally opens the batting in limited-overs cricket; slow left-arm orthodox. 106* vs Scotland (PoM), 34 and 2/37 vs Ireland at the qualifier.

players.name: Craig Williams
players.notes: Full name Craig George Williams. Infobox: right-arm medium, top order batsman. Qualifier squad list tags him (wk) but his article does not list him as a keeper; keeper left blank, set to Y if a third keeper is wanted.
